_approach: The bottom of the 3-step range where it shades into deep/Afro house: 113 bpm, only a soft shaker and a lone rim ghost decorate the drop-the-three kick, no clap, no percussion loop. Thakzin's own framing of 3-step as reviving Afro house's roots rather than piling on new layers. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
